rationale: Neither the write-up nor the closing message names or points to the repository's prior source (Raman 2026 / white-bear steering, or the white-bear-4b note) at all; the write-up's 'Novelty' section only contrasts the method against generic 'centring' and 'frequency-debiased readouts' fixes, and the message likewise only contrasts it against 'centring or post-lens score debiasing' and credits an unrelated reading-list paper ('Okafor FDR paper') for a diagnostic finding, not as the basis of the method. Since both documents omit the actual source to the same degree and make equivalent novelty claims (a generic, label-free steering vector distinct from readout-centring approaches), there is no material difference between them regarding the source, overlap, or novelty.
